notes: No ordering, atomic switch, or event drain is required. The customer change keeps the existing offer.queued event shape and all synchronous operation shapes, so old and new customer instances and old and new notifier instances can run together. During rollout, old customer instances may still queue offers for legacy implied-consent customers; new instances will not. Existing queued events remain valid. Rollback is safe by restoring the previous customer version; it may resume queuing implied-consent offers, while notifier versions continue consuming the unchanged event shape.
